title: Dispatch: condition->condition relationships implementation (attempt 1)
description:
Implement docs/design/condition-condition-relationships.md (revision 3, APPROVED, merged via PR #593 as 7452fbff), design §8 step 2. **Read the whole design doc first; it is the authority.** This spec records supervisor decisions and scoping; where it is silent, follow the design. Also read docs/importer-fix-protocol.md (this change touches the importer and the generated pack) and the module doc comment in packages/core/src/rules/recordRelationships.ts.

Worktree/branch: .worktrees/eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.3.1 on branch eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.3.1, cut from integration branch eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.3 (== origin/main 7452fbff). Install with `npm ci` in the worktree first.

## What to build (design refs)
1. **C1 resolver contract** (recordRelationships.ts): `relationByFieldValue` on record-name declarations; the new `excluded` / `relation-table-exclusion` outcome member exactly as the design's TS block specifies (sourceRecordKey, pointer, reason, relationFieldValue, declaration; NO relation/target/leaf value); resolution order steps 1-4 for table-bearing declarations; `buildRecordRelationshipManifest` validation rules (table only with record-name + relationField; non-empty keys; values non-empty string or null; at least one string value; NO `relation` beside a table). Update the module doc comment's "exactly one typed outcome" list to name all four. The resolver must never reach `declaration.relation as string` for a table-bearing declaration.
2. **C2** fixed-relation record-name (relationField omitted, `relation` used verbatim); `relationByFieldValue` without `relationField` rejected.
3. **C3 importer** (scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/conditionMechanics.ts, Grappled): add `triggerCondition: 'incapacitated'` ONLY to the `grappler-incapacitated` conditionEndsWhen effect; `trigger` unchanged; nothing on `removed-from-grappler-reach`. Check kindSchemas / condition effect validators accept the new field (extend them if they are closed), and field provenance stays covered by the existing (condition, /mechanics) declaration — verify, don't assume.
4. **C4 declarations** (scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/recordRelationshipDeclarations.ts): the two declarations exactly as in the design, with real `reason` strings. The `conditionEndsWhen: null` comment stays.
5. **C5 loader** (src/rules/packLoader.ts `parseRecordRelationshipDeclaration`): accept exactly the declared field set incl. `relationByFieldValue` (parse + shape-check it), throw RulesPackError naming any unknown key and its path. Run it against the committed SRD manifest and every in-repo fixture manifest; if any committed/fixture manifest is rejected, that is a design failure case (§8) — STOP and record it on this bead rather than loosening the check.
6. **Consumers**: discovery/expansion.ts loss accounting becomes an exhaustive per-outcome switch (a `never` check so a fifth outcome fails typecheck): `excluded` is recorded in relationshipResolutions, creates no traversal, and records NO StageLoss. Traversal passes that select only `resolved` stay unchanged. ruleAwareness / lookup_rules: NO code change (contract amended already as A2 in docs/design/rule-record-runtime-statements.md).
7. **Invariant 2 gate** (packages/core/test/rules/recordRelationships.test.ts, "resolves every declared reference occurrence in the committed pack"): exhaustive switch — resolved accepted; unresolved-target and indeterminate fail; excluded accepted ONLY when its (declaration.kind, declaration.pointerPrefix, relationFieldValue) triple is in an explicit justified-exclusion list whose only entry today is (condition, /mechanics/effects/*/condition, conditionEndsWhen); anything else fails. Rename the test to say it accepts resolved and justified-excluded occurrences. Prove the gate's discrimination ONCE BY OBSERVATION (temporarily inject a synthetic unresolved-target, indeterminate, and an unlisted excluded; see each fail; remove the injection) and record that observation in your completion notes — do NOT commit synthetic gate-discrimination tests (design §6: the gate itself is the permanent evidence).
8. **Regenerate** the pack via the importer (`npm run import:dnd5e-srd`, then `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack`). Never hand-edit records.json / record-relationships.json. Expected churn: condition:grappled gains triggerCondition; record-relationships.json gains the two declarations; hashes in manifest.json for changed artifacts only. field-provenance.json / source-*.json should not change — explain any change. Invariant 4: the five existing mechanics.conditions declaration objects must be byte-identical in record-relationships.json. Freeze-manifest untouched; no thaw note (freeze guard dormant until eshyra-o9bd.14).
9. **Inventory rerun**: `packages/core/scripts/inventory-semi-structured-boundary.ts` (find its npm/tsx invocation) and commit the regenerated inventory doc.

## Evidence (design §6 — permanent unless stated)
- Identity assertions on resolved edges in the committed pack (paralyzed/petrified/stunned -> implied-condition condition:incapacitated; unconscious -> implied-condition incapacitated + imposed-condition prone; grappled -> ending-trigger-condition incapacitated and no self-edge; every other condition record -> no condition-effect edges; exhaustion keeps exactly its lifecycle exception). Identities, not counts.
- Resolver unit tests with synthetic manifests: the four-distinct-outcomes test on one synthetic record (table string, table null incl. non-string leaf -> exactly one `excluded`, value absent from table -> indeterminate/relation-not-recognized, missing and non-string sibling -> indeterminate); fixed-relation record-name; every C1/C2 build rejection.
- Expansion unit test: excluded appears in relationshipResolutions, produces neither traversal nor StageLoss.
- Loader test: unknown declaration key rejected naming key and path.
- Invariant 7 committed-pack exclusion check: reads the resolver's actual `excluded` outcomes, reads the leaf at each outcome's pointer, asserts it equals the record's own normalized condition name.
- Importer test (conditionMechanics.test.ts): Grappled's triggerCondition present only on grappler-incapacitated; EXTEND any existing exact projection assertion, never weaken; cite the §2 source clause.
- lookup_rules envelope for condition:grappled carries the `excluded` outcome. **Put this in a NEW file packages/core/test/rules/conditionRelationships.test.ts** (see disjointness below); the identity assertions and invariant-7 check may live there too.
- Discovery probe (stunned seed -> incapacitated via expandTypedRelationships with the bundled manifest source): permanent ONLY if no existing probe already proves record-name expansion reaches discovery; otherwise observe once and drop, and say which in your notes.
- Discovery probe and intervention suites (test/discovery/discoveryProbes.test.ts, packetIntervention.test.ts) must stay green WITHOUT retuning any budget. If a new candidate displaces must-consider material, STOP and record it on this bead (design §8 failure case).

## Disjointness (hard constraint)
A sibling dispatch is concurrently editing the rule-channel datasets. Do NOT modify: packages/core/src/rules/ruleAdjudicationContext.ts, ruleKnownLimits.ts, deterministicCapabilityLedger.ts, ruleAwareness.ts, packages/core/scripts/create-dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle/ruleDispositions.ts, packages/core/test/rules/ruleAwareness.test.ts, packages/core/test/tools.test.ts, packages/core/test/ruleDispositions.test.ts, packages/core/test/deterministicCapabilityLedger.test.ts, docs/design/*. If you believe one of them must change, stop and record why on this bead.

## Completion report (bd update --append-notes)
Files changed; importer PR summary per docs/importer-fix-protocol.md (every generated change explained); the gate-discrimination observation; probe permanent-vs-dropped decision; any design deviation (there should be none — if the design is wrong, stop and record, don't improvise). Follow-ups via bd create.
